trayIntro: Drag a milestone onto the timeline, or use Schedule to place it for one week.
trayIntroReadOnly: These milestones have no dates yet. The team's manager or an administrator schedules them.
noMilestonesHint: Add the first milestone to plan this project.
stale: This milestone was moved by someone else in the meantime — the timeline was reloaded. Make your change again if you still want it.
saveForbidden: You are not allowed to change this
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid — check the team and the estimate
saveGone: This no longer exists — reload the page
scheduleForbidden: Only the team's manager or an administrator can schedule this milestone
scheduleInvalid: These dates cannot be saved: the end must not be before the start, and a milestone must cover at least one working day (Monday to Friday).
busy: A save is still running — try your change again in a moment.
milestoneGone: This milestone no longer exists — it was removed in the meantime.

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters
validation.estimateInvalid: Enter man-days from 0, with at most two decimals
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must not be before the start
validation.noWorkingDay: A milestone must cover at least one working day (Monday to Friday)

milestone.scheduleHint: Both dates are inclusive. Unschedule moves the milestone back to the Unscheduled list.
milestone.saveConflict: A milestone with this name already exists in this project
milestone.teamHint: The team's manager (or an administrator) schedules the milestone.
milestone.estimateHint: In man-days, in steps of a quarter day.

deleteProject.title: Delete project?
deleteProject.body_one: Project "{{name}}" and its {{count}} milestone will be deleted.
deleteProject.body_other: Project "{{name}}" and its {{count}} milestones will be deleted.

dependenciesIntro: A dependency makes one end wait for another: the successor waits for the predecessor. Links that do not hold are listed first and only warn — nothing is moved automatically.
noDependenciesHint: Link a milestone, or the whole project, to the work it waits for.

dependency.intro: The successor waits for the predecessor. The project's owner or an administrator adds and removes the project's links; the predecessor's owner is not asked. A link that does not hold only warns - nothing is moved.
dependency.successorHint: This project or one of its milestones - the side that waits.
dependency.predecessorHint: The side that is waited for.
dependency.lagHint: In working days (Monday to Friday); negative = a lead.
dependency.cycle: This link would close a cycle through:
dependency.duplicate: These two ends are already linked.
dependency.saveForbidden: Only the owners of the successor's project, or an administrator, can change its dependencies
dependency.saveInvalid: Check the successor and the predecessor — either may have been deleted meanwhile.

validation.selfLink: An end cannot depend on itself
validation.lagInvalid: Enter a whole number of working days from -365 to 365

dependency.deleteBody: The dependency {{predecessor}} → {{successor}} ({{type}}) will be deleted. Nothing moves.
dependency.deleteWith_one: Its {{count}} dependency will be deleted too.
dependency.deleteWith_other: Its {{count}} dependencies will be deleted too.
